Definition: fulness, i.e. (concretely) a plump socket (of the eye)
BiblicalUsage: The word is the setting of a jewel, and it appears once, in the bride's praise of her beloved: his eyes are like doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk and fitly set, like stones set in their sockets.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is of a beauty that fits: every part in its place, nothing forced, and the beloved described as a work of art.
